subject: Adopt mature free A2A foundations into autonomous Driver work
body: Read dore-design/knowledge-lab/a2a/mature-free-runtime-adoption-2026-09-01.md. Integrate mature free foundations by reuse-before-rebuild: A2A official protocol/Python SDK compatibility adapter and Inspector/TCK validation path; LangGraph durable state/checkpoint/resume patterns in an isolated Driver prototype; OpenHands-style portable skills evolution. Keep Temporal self-hosted as a later candidate, not a baseline dependency. Do not introduce paid hosted APIs. Preserve the existing dore.mail path and locked homepage #262. Run isolated verification before promotion, then resume the New Westside x Storybook parent goal. If the adoption script is absent, treat that as a capability gap and use the autonomous Driver/Research Bridge to create the smallest executable adoption experiment rather than asking the human.
